package.name: Docker Desktop
package.summary: Desktop container development application with platform prerequisites and subscription terms.

notes: Docker Desktop is a desktop application, not the standalone Docker Engine package.
Review WSL 2 or Hyper-V, hardware virtualization, supported Windows versions and native privilege prompts before installation; prerequisites may require a reboot.
A paid subscription may be required under the Docker Subscription Service Agreement; review vendor terms before approving.
Homebrew cask for Docker Desktop; review supported macOS versions and native privileged-helper prompts.
The reviewed cask requires macOS 14 or newer; architecture match alone does not establish OS-version compatibility.
A paid subscription may be required under vendor terms; review https://docs.docker.com/desktop/setup/install/windows-install/ before approving.

environment_guidance: A working Docker CLI does not prove Docker Desktop is installed or its daemon is running; native inventory and product-specific verification are required.
Virtualization features, user-group changes and container-service configuration require separate review and explicit consent.
